nodes.name: Doping p-Si
nodes.procedure: Single-crystal Si doped with elements in different valence states to form p-type semiconductor.
nodes.source_text: Intrinsic Si could be doped with elements in different valence states to form n-type or p-type semiconductors

nodes.name: Doping n-Si
nodes.procedure: Single-crystal Si doped with elements in different valence states to form n-type semiconductor.
nodes.source_text: Intrinsic Si could be doped with elements in different valence states to form n-type or p-type semiconductors

nodes.name: pn+ junction formation
nodes.procedure: Forming pn+ homojunction in p-Si substrate through thermal diffusion of phosphorus precursor as dopant source to create n+ emitter layer.
nodes.source_text: A phosphorus precursor was used as the dopant source in their investigation to form an n+ emitter layer.52–54

nodes.name: np+ junction formation
nodes.procedure: Forming np+ homojunction in n-Si substrate using ion implantation method with boron as the dopant source for PEC water oxidation.
nodes.source_text: Shi and colleagues fabricated an np+·Si photoanode using an ion implantation method with boron as the dopant source for PEC water oxidation.59

nodes.name: Si nanowire array etching
nodes.procedure: p-type Si nanowire array photocathode manufactured by metal-catalyzed electroless etching process on bulk Si substrate. Average diameter 100 nm, length 20 μm.
nodes.source_text: The nanowire array structure was obtained via a metal-catalyzed electroless etching process on the bulk Si substrate... average diameter and the length of the Si nanowire were 100 nm and 20 μm

nodes.name: TiO2 ALD deposition
nodes.procedure: TiO2 protection layers grown by atomic layer deposition (ALD) on Si-based photocathodes.
nodes.source_text: ALD-grown TiO2 protection layers could yield a long-term stability of more than 30 days

nodes.name: TiO2 hydrolysis
nodes.source_text: Titanium dioxide was prepared by hydrolyzing TiCl4

nodes.name: Pt nanoparticle loading
nodes.procedure: Loading Pt nanoparticles as electrocatalyst on Si nanowire electrode.
nodes.source_text: Upon loading Pt nanoparticles as the electrocatalyst

nodes.name: Al2O3 ALD deposition
nodes.procedure: 2 nm ALD-grown Al2O3 thin layer deposited as protection layer.
nodes.source_text: 2 nm ALD-grown Al2O3 thin layer in an electrolyte

nodes.name: Ni thin film evaporation
nodes.procedure: 2 nm Ni thin film deposited by e-beam evaporation.
nodes.source_text: n-Si protected with a 2 nm e-beam evaporation deposited Ni thin film

nodes.name: MoS2 magnetron sputtering
nodes.procedure: MoS2 layer prepared by magnetron sputtering followed by vulcanization.
nodes.source_text: MoS2 layer was prepared by magnetron sputtering, followed by vulcanization

nodes.name: Pyramid-textured Si etching
nodes.procedure: Pyramid-textured n+p-black Si photocathode fabricated via controllable Cu-catalyzed etching method.
nodes.source_text: Fang and Shen reported the fabrication of a pyramid-textured n+p-black Si photocathode via a controllable Cu-catalyzed etching method

nodes.name: SrTiO3 epitaxial growth
nodes.procedure: SrTiO3 epitaxial protective layer grown by molecular beam epitaxy on Si substrate.
nodes.source_text: Si-based photocathode with a thin SrTiO3 epitaxial protective layer grown by molecular beam epitaxy

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM reveals p-Si nanowire arrays with average diameter 100 nm and length 20 μm serving as antireflective light trapping layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The average diameter and the length of the Si nanowire were 100 nm and 20 μm, respectively. The nanowire array structure was obtained via a metal-catalyzed electroless etching process on the bulk Si substrate.
